title: Malioboro Run 2026 Review: Yogyakarta's Sold-Out Heritage-Street 21K
seo_title: Malioboro Run 2026 Review | Yogyakarta Indonesia Race
meta_description: Malioboro Run 2026: October 4 on Jalan Malioboro, Yogyakarta. 21K, 10K, 5K from Bank BPD DIY — now sold out. One of Indonesia's most atmospheric road races reviewed.
dek: Set for 4 October 2026 on Yogyakarta's iconic Jalan Malioboro — the cultural heart of Java — this Bank BPD DIY-organised half marathon is sold out. Three distances on one of Indonesia's most storied streets.
verdict: Malioboro Run is one of Indonesia's most atmospheric road races by sheer virtue of its venue: Jalan Malioboro, Yogyakarta's famous heritage street lined with batik shops, street-food stalls, and the Sultan's Palace (Kraton) at its southern end. Organised by Bank BPD DIY with strong local-government backing, the race has already sold out — a testament to its popularity. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K). For those who secured a spot: expect a flat, fast course through Jogja's cultural heart. For those who didn't: target the 2027 edition early.

sections.heading: Malioboro: Java's Most Famous Street
paragraphs: Jalan Malioboro is the cultural spine of Yogyakarta — a bustling heritage street with the Kraton at one end, Mount Merapi on the horizon, and Java's most vibrant street life in between. [1] The race is sold out, which speaks to both the quality of the venue and the depth of Jogja's running community. October is the tail of the dry season in Central Java.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: Sold out for 2026. Target the 2027 edition — and register early. 4 October 2026. [1]
